notes: Fastned's published charge curve for the Audi e-tron 55 Quattro | 95 kWh (2019 - 2022) (read from the page's embedded chart data, one value per % SoC; every 5 % kept plus the peak). Fastned states its curves show the car with the battery in optimal condition (about 30 C) on its 150+ kW-class chargers; cold or hot batteries charge slower. European-market car. e-tron 55 quattro 95 kWh, Fastned years 2019-2022; kept on the 2021-22 ids only (2019-20 have 83.6 kWh usable, 2023 is outside the page's range). Fastned's graph for this listing is byte-identical to its Q8 e-tron 50 quattro 89 kWh (2023-2024) listing (id 744, a different pack), so it may not be a measurement of this car. The Sportback 55 listing (id 137) is also identical (compared 2026-11-20). Peak 155 kW at 70 % against a stated DC peak of 150 kW. Linter warnings (flat_peak, off_template) expected: the first-gen e-tron holds about 150 kW up to roughly 70-80 % SoC, a known trait, not a data error.
